narr: Thunderstorms developed along a weak cold front during the midday hours and knocked down trees in parts of DeKalb County. Also, there was one report of flash flooding in the county.
ev: Water over a few roads in the Kilpatrick Community, such as AL Highway 68 near County Road 478 and County Road 179. Also County Road 24 and AL Highway 68. County Road 478 was barricaded by law enforcement. Depth of water unknown.
lsr: WATER OVER A FEW ROADS IN THE KILPATRICK COMMUNITY, SUCH AS AL HWY 68 NEAR CR 478 AND CR 179, AND CR 24 AND AL 68. CR 478 WAS BARRICADED BY LAW ENFORCEMENT.
